tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Granola API key and connectivity.

tools.name: list-notes
tools.description: List Granola meeting notes with optional filters. Returns notes with id, title, owner, created_at, updated_at. The API only returns notes that have an AI summary and transcript generated.

created_before.description: ISO date or datetime. Only notes created before this date are returned.

created_after.description: ISO date or datetime. Only notes created after this date are returned.

updated_after.description: ISO date or datetime. Only notes updated after this date are returned.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tools.name: get-note
tools.description: Get full details of a Granola meeting note by ID, including summary, attendees, calendar event, and optionally the transcript. The API only returns notes that have an AI summary and transcript generated.

includeTranscript.description: Whether to include the full transcript segments

tools.name: list-folders
tools.description: List Granola folders accessible to the user. Returns folder hierarchy via parent_folder_id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.
